Chloe / team —

I checked the traces and the bulk of the spikes align with two feature releases (search re-ranking and the new triage assistant) that landed mid-June and early July. Both features introduced heavier long-context sessions and some batched backfills. Expected behavior: sustained higher baseline for triage assistant (approx +18% steady-state), but the extreme weekday peaks were amplified by a two-week marketing pilot that has since ended.

Sizing recommendation (safe):
- Baseline: provision for 2x the current steady-state to absorb headroom (est. equivalent to 4 x A100-40GB-like units in our Dedicated pool model with continuous batching enabled).
- Burst corridor: leverage Dedicated burst capacity for scheduled campaigns (auto-scaled) — no change needed to model if campaigns are ad-hoc.

Performance: with the proposed config and prefix cache, we project 95th latency at ~230ms and median at ~65ms for typical inference paths.

Attachment: proposed_dedicated_config.xlsx (sheet includes GPU counts, expected concurrency, and prefix cache hit-rate assumptions).
